title: K1450's additive analytic-radius law necessarily collapses in finite time

radius_boundary.law: K1450 chooses R=rho^2 with R'(t)=-C B(t)
radius_boundary.coefficient_floor: B(t)=1+||E||_(H2)+||phi||_(H2)||D_t phi||_(H2) is at least one
radius_boundary.collapse_time: Every finite positive initial R reaches zero no later than R(0)/C, including the zero-field control
radius_boundary.conclusion: The specific K1450 absolute-value shrinking-radius estimate cannot by itself give a global positive analytic radius
radius_boundary.ceiling: This is a proof-method obstruction, not PDE blow-up. Sign cancellation, null forms, dispersive decay, modified energies and other topologies remain open
